applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations shown on electrical and utility plans
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown on the electrical and utility plans, but no dimensions, specifications, or clearance measurements are provided. No clearance distances are dimensioned between transformer pads and adjacent buildings or structures. Without dimensional information showing pad locations relative to buildings, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations; retaining walls shown on site plan
findings.comment: Multiple concrete retaining walls are shown on the site plan and grading plan. Transformer pads are depicted on the electrical plan, but no clearance dimensions are provided between pad locations and the retaining walls shown on plans. Compliance cannot be verified without dimensional documentation.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations and surrounding fencing/gate features
findings.comment: Pond perimeter fence and wood fencing are shown on the site plan. Transformer pads are located on electrical plans, but no clearance distances are dimensioned to the fences, and no documentation identifies which sides have operators/controls vs. no access. Compliance cannot be verified without specific clearance measurements and access door orientation.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are shown between transformer pads and buildings. Without measured clearance values, cannot determine if reduced 3-foot clearances are shown. Additionally, no Austin Energy Design written approval, confined space verification, window/door clearance documentation, fire rating specifications, or vertical clearance documentation is provided on the plans.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to building overhangs and balconies
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are provided between transformer pad locations and building elevations. Without dimensional documentation and cross-section drawings showing vertical clearances to building features, compliance with lateral clearance to balconies and overhead structure clearances cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No transformer equipment specifications are provided (no indication of oil-filled vs. dry-type). No clearance dimensions are shown between pads and building windows/doors/vents. Without specification of equipment type and dimensional clearance documentation to windows and doors, compliance with 12-foot horizontal clearance requirements cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations adjacent to sidewalks
findings.comment: Sidewalks are shown on the site plan (5-foot concrete sidewalks, decomposed granite walkways). Transformer pads are depicted on electrical plans, but no dimension lines or measurements are provided showing clearance distances from sidewalk back edges to pad locations. Compliance cannot be verified without specific measurements.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to stairwell locations
findings.comment: No stairwell or emergency egress locations are explicitly marked on the site plan. Transformer pad locations are shown without adjacent stairwell positions identified. Sufficient information to verify clearances to stairwells is not available on the submitted plans.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to fire escape structures
findings.comment: No fire escape structures are shown on the site plan or fire protection plan. Transformer pad locations lack specification as to equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) and show no dimensional clearances to any identified fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad hot-stick use areas (access door sides)
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan, but no pad specifications are provided (dimensions, orientation, access door location, phase type). Without specification of pad configuration and access door orientation, the 10-foot clearance requirement from access door side cannot be verified. No dimension lines show clearance from pad access doors to open areas or adjacent features.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to enclosed spaces, niches, or vault areas
findings.comment: No transformer pads are indicated as being located within niches, vaults, or notched-out building configurations on the site plan. No cross-section drawings are provided showing pad locations relative to enclosed or confined spaces. If pads are not in confined spaces, this item is inapplicable; however, this cannot be definitively confirmed from submitted plans.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to fire hydrants
findings.comment: Three fire hydrants are shown on the site plan (two internal, one off-site). Transformer pads (especially Pad 4 near southeastern area) are depicted on electrical plans near marked fire hydrants, but no clearance dimensions are provided between pad locations and hydrant positions. Compliance cannot be verified without specific measurements.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad proximity to vegetation and overhead electric lines
findings.comment: The landscape plan shows trees throughout the site, but transformer pad locations are not marked on the landscape plan. Specific tree species are identified by functional category (SY=Street Yard, PL=Parking Lot, M=Mitigation) but cross-reference to ECM Appendix F utility-compatible species is not provided. Without confirmed transformer pad locations on the landscape plan and species verification, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to shrubs and low vegetation
findings.comment: Landscape planting is shown on the landscape plan, but transformer pad locations are not marked or identified on the landscape sheet. Without confirmed location of each pad on the landscape plan and documented orientation of access doors, the 10-foot and 5-foot clearance requirements for vegetation cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
findings.comment: Trees are shown on the landscape plan and existing tree survey. Transformer pad locations and underground electric facility routing are shown on electrical plans, but transformer pad locations are not identified on the landscape plan. Without confirmed pad locations on the landscape plan, identification of trees within 20 lateral feet and root barrier detail specifications cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to dumpster locations
findings.comment: No dumpster or trash collection enclosure locations are specifically marked on the site plan. Transformer pad locations are shown without identifying adjacent trash/dumpster areas. Compliance with 5-foot clearance to dumpsters cannot be verified without identification of waste management facilities on the plans.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to bike rack locations
findings.comment: Bike parking is noted on the site plan (41 spaces provided: 39 long-term, 2 short-term), but specific locations of bike racks are not detailed on the plan sheets provided. Transformer pad locations lack clearance dimensions to bike racks. Compliance cannot be verified without specific bike rack locations and clearance measurements.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to light pole locations
findings.comment: Light poles are referenced in the site legend but specific locations and dimensions from transformer pads are not shown on electrical or site plans. Clearance distances from transformer pads to light poles are not dimensioned. Compliance cannot be verified without specific measurements.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to fire lanes
findings.comment: Fire lanes are shown on the Fire Protection Plan with red curb striping and signage details. Transformer pad locations are shown on electrical plans, but no dimension lines show clearance distances between pad locations and fire lane striping/routing. Compliance cannot be verified without specific measurements.

applicableAreas: Multiple transformer pad locations relative to each other
findings.comment: Four transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan. No dimension lines are provided showing clearance distances between individual pads. Compliance with 5-foot clearance between transformer pads cannot be verified without specific measurements between pad locations.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to water utility infrastructure
findings.comment: Proposed water lines are shown on the utility tap plans. Transformer pads are located on electrical plans, and multiple water line/electrical line crossings are visible. However, no clearance dimension lines or separation measurements are provided between transformer pad locations and water infrastructure. Compliance with 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to wastewater infrastructure
findings.comment: Proposed wastewater lines are shown on utility plans. Transformer pads are marked on electrical plans. Multiple electrical/wastewater line crossings are visible on Sheet 19 but no clearance measurements or separation dimensions are documented. Compliance with 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to storm drain infrastructure
findings.comment: Proposed storm drain lines are shown on utility and storm sewer plans. Transformer pads are depicted on electrical plans. Potential conflicts between transformer pad locations and storm drain infrastructure are not dimensioned or documented. Compliance with 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to gas utility infrastructure
findings.comment: Gas lines and gas meters are shown on the site plan. No gas pressure specifications are provided. Transformer pad locations lack clearance measurements to gas infrastructure. Without dimensional documentation and gas pressure specifications (to determine if 24-inch or 36-inch clearance applies), compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to other underground utilities
findings.comment: Multiple utility lines (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric, reclaimed water) are shown crossing on the utility tap plans. Transformer pad locations are shown on electrical plans, but no horizontal or vertical clearance dimensions are provided between pads and other underground utilities. Compliance with 12-inch minimum horizontal and vertical clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to utility crossings and building foundations
findings.comment: Utility lines cross at multiple locations on the site, and building footprints are shown on the site plan. Transformer pads are depicted on electrical plans, but no profile sections are provided showing vertical utility relationships or whether AE underground facilities are located under buildings or other utilities. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to overhead distribution lines
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines (OHE) are shown on landscape and utility plans, particularly along the southern property boundary. Transformer pad locations are shown on electrical plans, but no cross-section drawings or sky-to-ground clearance measurements are provided demonstrating 7.5-foot minimum clearance from overhead distribution conductors to ground-level transformer equipment. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines are shown on plans. Transformer pad locations are depicted on electrical plans. No dimension lines or measurements show the radial distance from overhead primary/neutral conductors to transformer pad locations. Compliance with 15-foot radius clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to building enclosures and niches
findings.comment: No transformer pads are indicated as being located within niches or enclosed areas on submitted plans. Site plan shows building footprints with no notched-out areas or enclosed pad installations. If niche service is not proposed, this item is inapplicable; however, no explicit documentation confirms this.

applicableAreas: Transformer niche installations (if applicable)
findings.comment: No niche service transformer installations are indicated on the site plan. No architectural specifications are provided for 3-hour fire wall ratings, ventilation, or AE Design coordination documentation. If niche service is not proposed, this item is inapplicable.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad access paths with potential overhead structures or enclosed areas
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in access paths to transformer pads. No overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas are indicated above transformer pad locations. Without cross-sections documenting vertical clearances, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations and surrounding grading/drainage
findings.comment: No transformer equipment type specifications are provided (oil-filled vs. dry-type). Grading plan shows general drainage patterns flowing away from buildings, but no specific drainage direction, slopes, or surface flow arrows are shown for the immediate transformer pad areas. Without equipment type specification and specific pad-area grading details, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown within the site boundaries. No explicit documentation is provided confirming 100% private property location. Pad locations relative to property lines and any ROW areas are not dimensioned. Compliance cannot be verified without explicit dimensional confirmation.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to recorded easements
findings.comment: Multiple easements are shown on grading and site plans (drainage, wastewater, electrical, public utility). Transformer pad locations are marked on electrical plans. No documentation is provided showing whether pads are located within or outside prohibited easement areas. Specific easement conflict analysis is not documented. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pad locations are shown on electrical plans without any easement boundaries or dimensions marked around them. No transformer easements are depicted or dimensioned on any plan sheets. Easement widths required for Austin Energy accessibility are not documented. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Electrical routing from transformer pads to electrical meters
findings.comment: Electrical routing from transformer pads to meters is shown on electrical plans (sheet 21 and 19). Routing appears to remain within site boundaries, but no explicit documentation or callouts confirm that 100% of electrical routing from transformers to meters is on private property. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pad locations are shown on electrical plans with zero dimension specifications. No pad dimensions (e.g., 6'x6', 10'x10'), service type (single-phase vs. three-phase), kVA rating, or references to Austin Energy Design-approved pad detail sheets are provided. Compliance with pad specification requirements cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads located within 4 feet of parking/vehicle circulation areas
findings.comment: Parking areas and vehicle circulation (24-foot driveways) are shown on the site plan. Transformer pad locations are marked on electrical plans. No dimension lines show distance from pad locations to parking or driveway edges. No bollard detail specifications, locations, or spacing are provided on any plan sheet. Compliance cannot be verified without specific measurements and bollard details.

applicableAreas: Overhead distribution line locations and proposed site features
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines are shown on landscape and utility plans (OHE on southern boundary). Proposed buildings, light poles, and other structures are depicted on site and landscape plans. No cross-section drawings or clearance documentation is provided showing that customer facilities are not installed under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities. Compliance cannot be verified.
